title: Making a game entirely with AI is not simple at all, guys.
author: crazy_dog_game
selftext:
I have no experience in game development, so I taught myself how to make a mobile game using AI. After that, I posted it in the group asking for feedback, and most people said the game looked really bad and didn’t look like a real game at all.

Then I used Claude Design to redesign the game to make it look better and posted it again for feedback. People still criticized it as bad/trash, and there were many detailed comments pointing out issues and suggesting ways to optimize it with AI.

I fed all the feedback to the AI and had it update the game. The result is a completely improved new version in every aspect — UI/UX, audio, gameplay, game feel…

Please try it out and let me know if it’s okay now, and if you have any more feedback.

Note: This is a hyper-casual game, easy to play, hard to master, with a mild level of frustration while playing.

Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.langbat.crazydog

iOS: https://apps.apple.com/app/crazy-dog/id6762199758
